description: SynthSeg 2.0 whole-brain segmentation, as projected from the Neurodesk Webapps automation.json contract. Exercises the RFC 0010 type qualifiers: formats on the input; an inputs.<id> space reference, a resolution and a labelSystem on the output.

mode.description: Fast mode skips flip averaging and topology postprocessing.

ct.description: Input is CT in Hounsfield units; omitted uses the app's intensity detection.

labels.description: Whole-brain segmentation resampled to a 1 mm grid in the input's space.

report.description: Per-label voxel counts and volumes in millilitres, with input and output checksums.
